en: A black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a village nestled among trees and surrounded by mountainous terrain. In the foreground, traditional Alpine-style buildings are visible, with a church tower toward the middle. The village is set against a dramatic mountain backdrop. At the bottom, the text 'VILLAZZANO DI TRENTO' is printed, indicating the location.
